residual.note: Measured: the level set's mean curvature over 120 on-surface samples. A nodal fit is a truncated Fourier series, not the minimal surface.

definition.note: Standard nodal approximation as shipped in math_art/minsurf/tpms.py. No exact definition is stored for this surface, so this approximation is all the record has; `approximates` is null rather than pointing at itself.
definition.level_function: (0.5 * (cos(x) * cos(y) * cos(z) + cos(x) * sin(y) * sin(z) + sin(x) * cos(y) * sin(z) + sin(x) * sin(y) * cos(z)) - 0.5 * (sin(2 * x) * sin(2 * y) + sin(2 * y) * sin(2 * z) + sin(2 * z) * sin(2 * x)) - 0.2)

derived_space_group.note: 2 groups of order 192 fix this surface (Fd-3m, Fd-3m:2); the group they generate is larger than any entry in the table, so the cell is coarser than the surface's own translational lattice and no single symbol is maximal

description.summary: D' is a triply periodic minimal surface, defined as a nodal algebraic surface, immersed, with a crystallographic space group.
